answer: Rank all identities by registration order and give each a payout share that decays geometrically with its rank among accounts from the same funding wave. The first account in a wave keeps most of the pool, while the tenth earns a tiny fraction, so a farm of n clones gains less and less from each additional account. Like a bridge of many arches whose last spans carry no load, or an anchor dragging behind a wharf, extra clones add cost without adding weight.
